def candidate(coords, features, target, i, j):
    from scipy.linalg import cho_factor
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    from scipy.optimize import minimize
    d = dist(coords)
    f = features @ features.T
    norm = np.mean(np.diag(f))
    f = f / max(norm, 1e-08)
    p = poly(coords)
    p = p @ p.T / np.mean(np.sum(p * p, 1))
    ii = np.ix_(i, i)
    ji = np.ix_(j, i)
    di = d[ii]
    fi = f[ii]
    pi = p[ii]
    y = target[i]
    mu = y.mean(0)
    sig = y.std(0)
    y = (y - mu) / sig

    def fun(theta):
        a = np.exp(theta)
        r = np.exp(-di @ a[:4])
        k = a[4] * r + a[5] * fi + a[6] * pi + a[7] * np.eye(len(i))
        cf = cho_factor(k)
        al = cho_solve(cf, y)
        inv = cho_solve(cf, np.eye(len(i)))
        obj = 0.5 * y @ al + np.log(np.diag(cf[0])).sum()
        w = 0.5 * (inv - np.outer(al, al))
        grad = np.r_[-a[:4] * np.einsum('ij,ijk->k', w * a[4] * r, di), np.sum(w * r) * a[4], np.sum(w * fi) * a[5], np.sum(w * pi) * a[6], np.trace(w) * a[7]]
        base = np.array([-1.4] * 4 + [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -8.0])
        reg = np.array([0.5] * 4 + [0.05] * 3 + [0.15])
        return (obj + np.sum(reg * (theta - base) ** 2), grad + 2 * reg * (theta - base))
    opt = minimize(fun, [-1.4] * 4 + [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -8.0], jac=True, method='L-BFGS-B', bounds=[(-5, 1)] * 4 + [(-9, 4)] * 3 + [(-12, -3)], options={'maxiter': 110})
    a = np.exp(opt.x)
    kernel = a[4] * np.exp(-d @ a[:4]) + a[5] * f + a[6] * p
    yp = mu + sig * (kernel[ji] @ np.linalg.solve(kernel[ii] + a[7] * np.eye(len(i)), y))
    return (yp, a)

def _coordinates(study, x):
    a = study['panel_a']
    (u, v) = (a['u'], a['v'])
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(len(u), 1)
    (du, dv) = (u[i] - u[j], v[i] - v[j])
    gain = np.array([np.median(dv[abs(du[:, k]) > 0.1, k] / du[abs(du[:, k]) > 0.1, k]) for k in range(u.shape[1])])
    offset = np.median(v - u * gain, axis=0)
    residual = np.linalg.norm(v - offset - u * gain, axis=1)
    median = np.median(residual)
    keep = residual <= max(8 * median, 0.001)
    if keep.sum() >= 2 * u.shape[1]:
        coef = [_least(_affine(u[keep, k:k + 1]), v[keep, k]) for k in range(u.shape[1])]
        (offset, gain) = np.array(coef).T
    cal = (x - offset) / gain
    b = study['panel_b']
    op = _least(_affine(b['u']), b['v'])
    return (x, cal, _affine(x) @ op, _affine(cal) @ op)
